name: mcpveil-cli
description: Deterministic security test suite for MCP servers: sends real payloads through live MCP sessions and confirms exploitability from responses. CI-native with SARIF 2.1.0 output for GitHub Code Scanning.
author: MCPVeil contributors

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run test/e2e
scripts.scan:vulnerable: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan --stdio "node_modules/.bin/tsx test/vulnerable-server/index.ts" --yes
scripts.scan:safe: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan --stdio "node_modules/.bin/tsx test/safe-server/index.ts" --yes
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:package
